description: Hymns sung to the same melody. The rw/fr/en editions share the numbering, so each group applies to every collection. Generated from the piano renders in /audio by scripts/analyze-melody-groups.mjs (key- and tempo-invariant melody comparison): linking pairs scored >= 0.875 and every pair inside a group >= 0.84 (random pairs never exceed 0.80). Edit by hand to correct; users' own additions/removals are stored separately on the device. Reviewed by ear by the maintainer on 2026-11-08: all groups confirmed; 7 missing links added (30-67-81, 93-269, 138, 148, 89, 31-68, 116); 252 rejected for 149-253.
